Please like, share, comment The Oklahoma City Thunder may have won the game against the LA Clippers, but they lost something much bigger. With just 1:14 left in the 4th quarter, OKC All-Star guard Jalen Williams drove to the basket for a dunk and was hit hard by Kris Dunn and Derrick Jones Jr. in mid-air. JDub fell awkwardly, pinning his left leg underneath his body weight in a gruesome, terrifying lower-leg injury. You could hear a pin drop inside the Paycom Center as a towel was immediately thrown over his leg and medical staff rushed out with a stretcher. The reactions from his teammates were painful to watch—Chet Holmgren covered his eyes in shock, and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander was seen fighting back tears with his jersey over his face. But the LAST moment is absolutely heartbreaking. As JDub was being stretchered off the floor, the entire arena broke into a standing ovation, chanting his name and letting out a chorus of the famous Thunder barks. Through absolute agony, Jalen Williams looked up and gave the home crowd two thumbs up. the NBA was founded on June 6, 1946, in New York City, originally under the name Basketball Association of America (BAA). It was created by owners of major arenas who wanted to fill their venues with professional basketball games. The BAA played its first season in 1946, with the Philadelphia Warriors winning the first championship. In 1949, the BAA merged with the rival National Basketball League (NBL) and became the National Basketball Association (NBA). Since then, the NBA has grown into one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world.#foryoupage #funny #trending #viral #throwback
